scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: An analytic all-height proof is supplied; finite exact-integer calculations are only supplementary checks.
limitations: Only 2-by-2 canonical integral companion matrices, ordered by trace-determinant height; not entrywise matrix counts.
The geometric smooth-Markov iff criterion is imported from Hughes and de Jong (2026), not re-proved.
No geometric construction or minimal partition-cardinality bound follows from this count.
Historical bibliographic priority of an equivalent arithmetic count is not independently certified.

title: A divisor-sum census of smooth Markov partitions for quadratic companion toral maps
